name: claim_admin_kpi
xsql:
SELECT FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Approved' AND Nvl(c.uploaded_flag, 'N') <> 'Y' THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0') AS ready_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Uploaded' THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0')  AS uploaded_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Submitted' THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0') AS pending_review_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Approved' AND Nvl(c.uploaded_flag, 'N') <> 'Y' THEN c.claim_amount END), 0), '$#,###0.00') AS ready_value,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Uploaded' THEN c.claim_amount END), 0), '$#,###0.00') AS uploaded_value
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  ( Nvl(:v_period, '') = '' OR Nvl(:v_period, '') = 'All' OR c.period_name = :v_period )
